name: carbon_water_trap
note: Low carbon holds less water, which limits biomass, which returns less carbon.

name: simplified_system_biodiversity_loss
note: A single-species system supplies few niches, so soil and above-ground diversity fall together.

name: exposed_soil_erosion_risk
note: Carbon-poor bare soil erodes, losing the nutrients that would rebuild cover.

name: fragmented_dryland
note: Scarce natural cover in a dry landscape leaves little refuge for pollinators and soil biota.
